cues.text: A blonde girl in a long dress stands alone by the sea.
Junpei, Akihiko and the hero watch her.
Junpei stretches, then walks up to the girl.
Akihiko pats the hero's head and walks over to her.
Akihiko freezes, then rejoins the others.
The hero walks over to the girl.
The hero murmurs something to her.
She spins around and runs off past the hero.
